text: dsh-notify 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 网页端的会话完成通知插件。它通过浏览器客户端注入 sessions 服务，监听会话运行状态，并在运行中的会话转为空闲时显示系统通知。通知仅在用户切换到其他标签页、窗口失去焦点或完成任务的会话不是当前选中会话时触发；通知标题使用会话名称，并按会话标记以替换重复通知。插件会在首次点击或键盘操作时请求浏览器通知权限，没有按钮、设置界面或主机端功能。适合希望切换窗口后及时获知 DSH 任务完成的网页端用户；需要启用浏览器通知权限，不需要额外密钥或外部服务。

dsh-notify alerts DeepSeek Harness web users when a session becomes idle while they are away or viewing another session. It uses the session title and replaces repeat alerts. Permission is requested on first interaction. Requires browser notification permission; no API key or external service.
我切到别的标签页后，想知道 DSH 什么时候跑完。
能不能在网页任务完成时弹出系统通知？
让 DSH 会话结束时提醒我，不用一直盯着页面。
切去其他应用后，怎么收到模型任务完成的提示？
Notify me when a web session finishes while I am in another tab.
I want an alert when a DSH run finishes in the background.
dsh-notify 的功能「会话完成提醒」：监听 DSH 会话的运行状态，在 running 转为 idle 时检查用户是否正查看该会话；用户离开页面或当前选中其他会话时，浏览器显示带会话名称的系统通知。
dsh-notify 的功能「首次操作请求权限」：客户端加载后监听首次 pointerdown 或 keydown，在用户操作时请求浏览器通知权限；权限请求监听器随后移除。
dsh-notify 的功能「按会话替换通知」：每条系统通知使用会话 ID 作为 tag，同一会话后续通知会替换已有通知，而不会重复堆叠。
dsh-notify 使用浏览器系统通知权限；用户拒绝后插件不会显示通知，权限由浏览器管理。首次请求在点击或键盘操作时发起。
dsh-notify 仅提供系统通知，没有用户可见的启停开关、应用内完成提示或声音；通知行为不能在插件界面内调整。
DSH 在后台跑任务时，完成了能提醒我吗？
Show me a system alert if a different session completes.

dsh-notify README · dsh-notify：> Browser notification for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web UI — get a system notification the moment a session finishes running.

`dsh-notify` is a small, behavior-only **Web client plugin** for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`). When you hand the model a long task and switch to another tab or application, it raises a browser notification the instant the task completes, so you never have to keep checking back.

dsh-notify README · Features：- 🛎️ **System notification on completion** — fires exactly when a session's `running` state flips to idle, titled with the session name and a Chinese completion body.
- 👀 **No noise while you watch** — it stays silent only when you are actively looking at the session that just finished. It notifies when:
  - the page is hidden (you switched tab), or
  - the browser window lost focus (you switched to another app), or
  - the completing session is not the currently selected one.
- 🔁 **Per-session dedup** — each notification is tagged by session, so a repeat replaces the previous instead of stacking.
- 🔐 **Permission asked at the right moment** — the permission prompt appears on your first click or keystroke, not while you are away (this is what makes it work in Safari).
- ⚙️ **Zero UI** — no buttons, no settings screen, no host-side changes. It is one browser row in your profile.

dsh-notify README · Requirements：- [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) with the Web UI (`dsh web`, or `dsh --profile web`).
- A modern browser. The Web UI runs on `http://127.0.0.1:<port>`, which is a secure context, so the `Notification` API is available.
- On macOS, also allow the browser in **System Settings → Notifications**, otherwise the OS suppresses the banner even when the page has permission.

dsh-notify README · Install：`dsh-notify` is an installable **bundle**. Install it into a profile from npm, a tarball, or straight from this repository.

```sh
dsh-notify README · from GitHub (this repo)：dsh plugin --profile web add github:you/dsh-notify
dsh-notify README · from npm：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-notify

dsh-notify README · from a local checkout or packed tarball：dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-notify
```

`dsh plugin` forwards to pnpm, so any pnpm spec works. Installing a bundle appends it to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` and applies its patch layer; no manual `cordis.yml` editing is needed.

> **GitHub installs need no build step.** This repository commits its built `lib/`, so `dsh plugin add github:you/dsh-notify` works directly, with no install-time build allowance to grant.

dsh-notify README · Usage：Install, then boot the Web UI and grant the notification permission the first time the browser asks (on your first click or keystroke):

```sh
dsh --profile web
```

Start a task in any session, switch away, and a system notification appears when the model finishes. There is nothing else to configure.

dsh-notify README · How it works：The plugin injects the runtime's `sessions` service and subscribes to the session list snapshot — the same fact source the sidebar reads. A small fold keeps each session's previous `running` bit, records the first observation without notifying, and dispatches one notification per `running → idle` edge, gated by the "are you looking at this session" rule above.

dsh-notify README · How it works：The browser half is a CJS bundle registered through `window.__ModuleLoader__.load`, which the harness's client module system scans and serves under `/plugins/dsh-notify/client.js`. The node half is a no-op host plugin body.

dsh-notify README · Development：```sh
pnpm install     # install dev tooling
pnpm build       # bundle lib/index.js (node) and lib/client.js (browser)
pnpm typecheck   # tsc --noEmit
pnpm test        # vitest

Build artifacts are committed under `lib/` so GitHub installs work without a build step.

```
dsh-notify/
├── package.json        # dsh.client + dsh.bundle.patch manifests
├── cordis.patch.yml    # bundle layer: inserts the dsh-notify row
├── tsdown.config.ts    # builds the node half and browser half

dsh-notify README · Known limitations：- **Always on** — there is no user-facing toggle yet. A settings row (enable/disable, sound, only-when-hidden) is the natural follow-up.
- **System notification only** — completion does not also produce an in-app toast or a title flash; the sidebar's built-in green "done" dot remains the in-app signal.
- **Browser-owned permission** — if the user denies the permission prompt, the plugin is disabled for that origin with no in-app recovery.
- **No sound** — a short chime is deferred.
